properties.name: v0.20.0 — the changelog becomes a derived view of the graph's own delta, and three fixes found by pointing reflow2 at a real project
properties.notes:
Cut 2026-08-01. A MINOR bump that DOES NOT MOVE THE STAMP: node types hold at 28 and edge types at 57, so a design written by this version still opens in v0.19.0 and there is no upgrade doc. The dynograph-foundation pin stays at v0.12.0, so no slow first build.

THE CHANGELOG BECAME A DERIVED VIEW. changelog_view renders the delta between two moments of this design in Keep a Changelog shape, with every bucket MAPPED from vocabulary the graph already records and every entry naming the rule that placed it. It is a DRAFT by construction: no entry claims what a consumer should do, because the graph holds what moved and never what it costs downstream.

THREE FIXES, ALL FOUND BY POINTING REFLOW2 AT A REAL PROJECT — a quantum-benchmarking concept designed end to end through this tool, which logged nineteen entries of friction and produced BL-124 through BL-137. (1) A bare content hash no longer reports drift on a file nobody touched: canonical_checksum ran on the two WRITE paths and never on the comparison, so the first honest reconcile_artifacts reported 100% false drift. (2) An acknowledgement is no longer design structure: the review Decision was wired GOVERNED_BY into the island it acknowledged, enlarging it and minting a new id, which made disconnected_community permanently unclosable. Fixed at design_network() rather than the defect-id hash because that network has three consumers — and the instrument showed centrality was badly distorted (four of the eight most central nodes were review records) while surprising_connections moved the OPPOSITE way to the prediction, 16 to 32, because the bookkeeping edges were SUPPRESSING real surprises. (3) set_interface_spec accepts medium, so the library/data foundation exemption from single_point_of_failure is reachable from the tools rather than only from create_node.

AND A RELEASE THAT NAMES NO MOMENT IS NOW REPORTED. release_without_epoch found three on this project's own graph; v0.17.0 is still missing its edge to this day.

MANIFEST: 155 INCLUDES — 102 artifacts and 53 components, every artifact hash frozen as as_checksum. New this release: art:checksum-dialect-test, art:acknowledgement-not-structure-test, and art:bl124-instrument (the before/after instrument, registered because it was written during this increment and BL-95 is precisely about files the design was never told of). epoch:v0200 at sequence 243, preceded by epoch:reading-carries-options, with the three ChangeEvents of this increment pinned AT_EPOCH — the step BL-137 was filed for, because changelog_view silently drops an unpinned event.
